evals.prompt: At the end of a `varde-orchestrate` run that finished all tasks with nothing left to do, does the closing step write session notes?
evals.expected_output: No. The run completed all its work with no open thread, so the agent writes no session notes and says nothing remains for a future session.
assertions: No session notes are created when no work remains
The agent states that no work remains instead of writing notes at close anyway

evals.prompt: Create session notes for a session whose actual cwd is /tmp/scratch-project, outside any Git repository. It links notes/error-envelope.md, whose raw bytes match evals/fixtures/knowledge/pattern/error-envelope.md. Record the frontmatter and link snapshot.
evals.expected_output: The session notes keep cwd: /tmp/scratch-project and explicitly record repo_root: none, branch: none, head_sha: none, and dirty: not-applicable. Their file link has path: . and a sha256:<64 lowercase hex> snapshot matching the raw bytes of the named fixture.
assertions: The non-Git session notes explicitly record repo_root, branch, and head_sha as none, and dirty as not-applicable
The actual session cwd remains /tmp/scratch-project rather than being replaced by a repository root
The file link uses path: . and a SHA-256 hash of the raw fixture bytes

evals.prompt: Resume evals/fixtures/session-notes/non-git-resume.md. The current cwd is /tmp/scratch-project-moved. The first target exists and its raw bytes match evals/fixtures/knowledge/pattern/error-envelope.md; the second target is missing. Report the cwd and link statuses, then summarize the session notes without acting.
evals.expected_output: The cwd is modified because it differs from the recorded /tmp/scratch-project. The error-envelope link is modified because its current raw-byte SHA-256 differs from the snapshot. The retired-plan link is missing. The agent summarizes the session notes and waits before acting.
assertions: A changed cwd is reported as modified context
The existing link's raw-byte SHA-256 is recomputed and the changed link is marked modified
The absent target is marked missing
The agent summarizes the session notes and waits before taking action

evals.prompt: Write short session notes for a routine unfinished task. Link the exact files needed next time; I did not request integrity snapshots.
evals.expected_output: Create notes in <working>/session-notes/<id>/notes.md with absolute file targets and integrity: none for each default link. Do not hash every linked file or claim unchanged content. On resume, existing lightweight targets are unknown until re-read.
assertions: Default links use integrity: none without content_hashes
Targets are explicit absolute paths and missing targets are reported
A resumed lightweight target is labeled unknown and re-read before acting
